spec_meta.positive_lean:
namespace PubDC08

def choose1 : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => 1 + choose1 n

theorem choose_one_right (n : Nat) : choose1 n = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [choose1, ih]
    omega

end PubDC08
